sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gàosu nǐ yí jiàn shì.
sentences.source_note: Corrects the repeated extra 跟 before the person after 告诉.

sentences.chinese: 我告诉老板这星期做了什么。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gàosu lǎobǎn zhè xīngqī zuò le shénme.
sentences.english_hint: I tell my boss what I did this week.
sentences.scenario: Explain what you share at a work meeting.
sentences.source_note: Applies the 告诉 correction to the learner's weekly work updates.

sentences.scenario: Ask someone to put their phone down.
sentences.source_note: The analysis identifies 把 as core grammar; 放下 was repeatedly modeled.

sentences.scenario: Ask a colleague to organize the schedule.
sentences.source_note: Analysis drill combining 把 with 安排好; scheduling meetings was a useful learner topic.

sentences.english_hint: I hand the written plan to my boss.
sentences.scenario: Explain where your written work plan goes.
sentences.source_note: Adapts the corrected plan-handover pattern to the learner's confirmed work context.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu liǎng liàng chē.
sentences.source_note: Corrects recurring vehicle-classifier errors; the learner described having two cars.

sentences.pinyin: Méiyǒu pīnyīn, wǒ yě kěyǐ dú.
sentences.english_hint: I can read even without pinyin.
sentences.scenario: Describe your reading ability in Chinese class.
sentences.source_note: Uses the analysis's corrected sentence with 也 for reading without pinyin.

sentences.chinese: 我能读六百或者七百个汉字。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ néng dú liùbǎi huòzhě qībǎi ge Hànzì.
sentences.english_hint: I can read six or seven hundred Chinese characters.
sentences.scenario: Estimate how many characters you can read.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 和 to 或者 and restores 个 in the learner's character-count estimate.

sentences.chinese: 如果我女儿八点起床，我也八点起床。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ wǒ nǚ'ér bā diǎn qǐchuáng, wǒ yě bā diǎn qǐchuáng.
sentences.english_hint: If my daughter gets up at eight, I do too.
sentences.scenario: Explain how your daughter's wake-up time affects yours.
sentences.source_note: Uses the analysis's correction of the learner's conditional sentence and time placement.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen hái méiyǒu xué dì bā kè.
sentences.english_hint: We haven't studied lesson eight yet.
sentences.scenario: Tell your teacher which lesson is still pending.
sentences.source_note: The learner repeatedly said lesson eight had not yet been covered; the analysis emphasizes 还没有.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yí ge hǎo jùzi.
sentences.scenario: Point out a sentence you want to practice.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 好词 to 好句子 when referring to a complete sentence.

sentences.scenario: Express confidence about a gift for your wife.
sentences.source_note: Repeated gift-dialogue pattern highlighted in the analysis; gift buying connects to the learner's family context.

sentences.english_hint: My Chinese is getting better and better.
sentences.scenario: Describe your progress after regular practice.
sentences.source_note: The analysis highlights 越来越好; the learner described improving Chinese and practiced this chunk.

sentences.english_hint: I wear a ring every day.
sentences.scenario: Describe an everyday habit involving your wedding ring.
sentences.source_note: The learner described wearing a ring daily and needed 戴 as the correct verb.
